data.one_liner: In-app live chat and knowledge base widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop‑in chat widget that lets users contact support from any screen. It supports iOS and Android, is GDPR compliant, and can be initialized with app and access keys.
use_when: You need an in‑app live chat feature
You target both iOS and Android
You want a quick, native‑looking chat UI
avoid_when: You only need a backend SDK without UI
You prefer a pure Dart solution without native code
strengths: Rich API for launching chat and customizing appearance
weaknesses: Requires native setup (pod install, Gradle repo, permissions)
Only provides chat UI, no backend integration
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, run flutter pub get, run pod install for iOS, add maven repo for Android, add internet permission, add ProGuard rule if minifying, generate app/access keys in Zoho console, initialize in Dart with ZohoSalesIQ.initialize()
